row.text: Write up quiet hours for notices as a design page.

Sent back "Quiet hours for notices" with your notes.
Why 9:00? I start at 8, and on Fridays I want the digest at 7:30 so I can clear it before standup.
9:00 is the work start in Settings. I can tie quiet hours to your own work start instead, so they end at 8:00 for you.

Sent back "Quiet hours for notices" with your notes.
Yes, tie it to my work start. And should a failed check on a branch wake me? I only care about main.
No: a failed check on a branch can wait for the digest. Only one on main stops other Jobs. The page will say both in its next revision.
